description: REPLICA housed in a purpose-built exhibition hall in the Korean Provisional Government commemorative space in Yeouido Park; commemorates the C-47 that flew Kim Ku and the Provisional Government leadership into Yeouido airfield on 1945-11-23; the OSM object was re-surveyed 2024-06-27; whether an original airframe or a full-scale reconstruction is inside was NOT established and it is recorded as a replica pending confirmation
museum_name: Yeouido Park C-47 Exhibition Hall -- Seoul
